text: Keep potatoes away from onions: onions release moisture and gases that can encourage potatoes to sprout sooner. A cool, dark, ventilated cupboard suits potatoes better.
Public libraries lend more than books: many offer tool-lending collections, letting neighbours share drills and other occasional-use kit instead of each household buying its own.
On your next visit to a park, library or community hall, take a moment to check its noticeboard and straighten one slipped flyer so useful local information stays visible.
